extra.status: Legacy model: compatible with ... SGT-100, SGT-300, and SGT-400, as well as in the legacy ... fleet model SGT-200. (EVGV upgrade flyer, Siemens Energy, PDF dated 2026-02-27, https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/58b94f37-1abf-4e19-aa5f-b4a50085bfae/EVGVUP~1-PDF_Original%20file.PDF). Not in the current Siemens Energy gas-turbine portfolio, 0-15 MW industrial list: 'SGT-A05 [4 to 6 MW] ... SGT-100 [5 / 6 MW] ... SGT-300 [8 / 8 to 9 MW] ... SGT-400 [10 to 14 / 11 to 15 MW]' (GT-Portfolio-Brochure, PDF dated 2026-01-21, https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/4b92fab0-08bf-4ffe-8eb9-b3da0096cddd/GT-Portfolio-Brochure__HQ-pdf_Original%20file.pdf).
extra.fuel_system: Gas fuel control retrofit (IFV) applies to SGT-200: 'SGT-300, and SGT-400, as well as in the legacy fleet ... models TB and SGT-200. It replaces all previous non-IFV, ... gas fuel control systems with the latest technology.'; 'no need for the now obsolete, double diaphragm regulator ... This can translate to a lower required ... gas fuel supply pressure.'; 'Up to 3 IFVs may be required depending on the number ... of gas streams i.e. whether the engine is non-DLE, DLE ... or EDLE.' (IFV upgrade flyer, PDF dated 2026-03-12, https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/68090946-00cd-4874-b448-b46400e22761/IFV-Upgrade-Flyer_SGT-pdf_Original%20file.pdf). Required fuel-gas supply pressure: not published.
extra.combustion: Both DLE and non-DLE (diffusion) exist: 'Siemens Energy small industrial gas turbines SGT-100, 200, 300 and 400 use G30 burner technology, a proven radial [swirler premixing design]'; 'The SGT-200 and SGT-400 with non-DLE combustion systems have more than one million operating hours in coke oven gas applications' (Siemens Energy hydrogen white paper 2025, https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/246c6ce6-853f-4aff-8d28-b44900b0c002/hydrogen-gt-white-paper-pdf_Original%20file.pdf). Hydrogen conversion flyer: 'Applicable fleet SGT-400, SGT-300, SGT-200, SGT-100' (https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/e8a73ac0-0b2d-4346-b2b6-b05d009c604a/SGTupdateHydrogenconversion-pdf_Original%20file.pdf).
extra.variable_geometry: Variable guide vanes present (number of variable rows not published): 'The variable guide vanes (VGVs) are located within the ... compressor stage of a gas turbine and control the air flow ... VGV actuation systems have historically ... been either hydraulic, pneumatic or electric'; EVGV electric actuator retrofit 'compatible with ... SGT-100, SGT-300, and SGT-400, as well as in the legacy ... fleet model SGT-200.' (https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/58b94f37-1abf-4e19-aa5f-b4a50085bfae/EVGVUP~1-PDF_Original%20file.PDF). Original SGT-200 actuator type (hydraulic / pneumatic / electric) not stated for this model.
extra.power_upgrade: Siemens Energy SGT Power Upgrade (flyer 2022): 'Our power upgrade solutions offers the ability to increase output up to 5.7MWe on the ... SGT-100, 7.68MWe on the SGT-200 and finally 14.4MWe on the SGT-400, depending on ... the package and site location.'; scope 'Replacement Gas Generator ... Replacement Power Turbine' (https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/83dbc9bc-b4f0-4954-8a59-b05d00980212/SGTPowerUpgradev2-pdf_Original%20file.pdf). 7.68 MWe is an upgraded maximum, not the ISO base rating; the flyer names no variant.
extra.shaft_configurations_fleet: Remote witness test page lists 'SGT-100, SGT-200, SGT-300 & SGT-400 plus TB units ... Applicable for both ... 1S and 2S single and double shaft configurations' (https://www.siemens-energy.com/us/en/home/products-services/service/sgt-100-400-tb.html) - fleet-level statement for SGT-100...400, not tied to an SGT-200 variant.
extra.reliability_note_for_replacement: Fleet-level, not stated per SGT-200 unit or variant: the EVGV flyer says VGV actuation across the SEITL SGT fleet 'historically been either hydraulic, pneumatic or electric' and that replacing hydraulic or pneumatic systems will 'remove the complexity of additional systems (e.g. hydraulic pumps, filters, accumulators)' (https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/58b94f37-1abf-4e19-aa5f-b4a50085bfae/EVGVUP~1-PDF_Original%20file.PDF); the IFV flyer says the IFV 'simplifies the gas fuel train with no need for the now obsolete, double diaphragm regulator' and 'replaces all previous non-IFV, gas fuel control systems' (https://assets.siemens-energy.com/dam/68090946-00cd-4874-b448-b46400e22761/IFV-Upgrade-Flyer_SGT-pdf_Original%20file.pdf). Which actuator type and whether a double diaphragm regulator a given SGT-200 has is not stated.

prelim_unverified.notes: Data from a copy of the Siemens SGT-200 datasheet (no current siemens-energy.com product page found). Older Siemens brochure gives 6.75 MW(e). Turbine stage count for the single-shaft version not found. Siemens manual gives height 3.0 m to frame / 3.3 m to enclosure top, 56,250 kg.

What the open Siemens Energy documents do confirm for SGT-200: legacy status, variable guide vanes, gas-fuel IFV retrofit, DLE (G30) and non-DLE combustion, upgrade to 'up to 7.68MWe'. Preliminary values are kept only in extra.prelim_unverified with their original (unopened) URLs. Preliminary (unverified) conflicts to resolve when the data sheet is opened: power 6800 kW (soar.hk copy) vs 6.75 MW(e) (older Siemens brochure copy, china-power-contractor.cn); package height 3.4 m vs Siemens manual copy 3.0 m to frame / 3.3 m to enclosure top, weight 56 245 vs 56 250 kg (manualmachine.com); turbine stage count of the single-shaft engine not found. eff_pct would be 3600/heat_rate once heat rate is confirmed. To finish: allow www.soar.hk (Siemens data sheet copy) and/or pdf.directindustry.com, etn.global, www.forecastinternational.com, manualmachine.com in the session network settings, or obtain the Siemens SGT-200 data sheet / package GA drawing from the operator. Skeptic re-check 14.11.2026: product page .../product/sgt-200.html still HTTP 404; the 47 locale sitemaps of siemens-energy.com (3318 URLs) list no SGT-200 page (only sgt-100, sgt-300 product pages and the sgt-100-400-tb service page); the small-industrial-gas-turbine service page links only the EVGV, IFV, SGT-300-1S aerofoil and hydrogen-conversion flyers; GT portfolio brochure (2026-01-21) has no SGT-200 row; centraxgt.com products, pre-owned, history and case-study pages and the manualsdir.com Siemens list have no SGT-200. All Siemens Energy quotes in extra re-read in the PDFs. Note: the only open Siemens Energy number near the MD rating, '7.68MWe on the SGT-200' (power upgrade flyer 2022), is an upgraded electrical maximum ('increase ... between 0.3MWe and 1.5MWe based on ISO Conditions'), so it cannot stand in for a base or MD shaft rating.
